mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 4.0% consistently predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days by signaling accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates and supports equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 4.0% (using historical data from 2000-2011), or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate exceeding 0.5 percentage points over one month signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger risk-off sentiment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when UNRATE rises >0.5pp in 1 month (using historical data from 2000-2011), or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) over the past two months indicate broad-based consumer demand weakness, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline in the past 2 months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline in the past 2 months (using historical data from 2000-2011), or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL annual change > 3.0%) trigger Federal Reserve tightening expectations that increase discount rates and reduce equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when CPIAUCSL annual change > 3.0% (using historical data from 2000-2011), or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high industrial production level (above 105) indicates robust economic activity that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when INDPRO > 105 (using historical data from 2000-2011), or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong non-farm payroll growth exceeding 200,000 jobs in a month signals a robust labor market that boosts consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >60% of instances when PAYEMS > 200,000 (using historical data from 2000-2011), or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in real GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) over the past four months indicate a broad economic slowdown, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and HOUST both decline in the past 4 months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when both GDPC1 and HOUST decline in the past 4 months (using historical data from 2000-2011), or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising >0.25pp in 3 months and CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) increase borrowing costs and reduce corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp in 3 months and CPIAUCSL > 2.5%
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises >0.25pp in 3 months and CPIAUCSL > 2.5% (using historical data from 2000-2011), or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is <0.03.
